problem: A long-running chat showed 'Streaming onderbroken. Wachten op het volledige bericht…', making it appear that execution had stopped and risking loss of continuity.
root_cause: Material work could span too much uninterrupted chat/tool execution without a user-visible terminal outcome and without sufficiently frequent canonical checkpoints.
prevention: execute material work in bounded resumable batches
checkpoint before and after material external side effects
read back uncertain side effects before replay after a stream break
resume from canonical state without requiring the user to say continue again
separate compact user-facing progress from internal CI/provider polling
